tests.title: Customer books an appointment on the eShop and staff see it in the CRM
tests.goal: The customer-side appointment booking at /appointment works end to end.
preconditions: An appointment resource with a free future slot, found at runtime (resource 3 "Course" per context.md)
data: A future free slot chosen at runtime

steps.text: Open /appointment and pick the resource and a free future slot
Open the member account bookings (if shown) and the CRM Appointments list for that date

expected.text: Step 2: a confirmation with the date and time
Step 3: the booking shows for the member and in the CRM; the slot is no longer free for another customer

checks.label: Step 2: a confirmation with the date and time
Step 3: the booking shows for the member and in the CRM; the slot is no longer free for another customer

notes: One approved QA member booking, no retry: Thai, eShop resource Course (3), 2026-11-02 10:00-10:30, remark SBF-040-MVUT1XJ4. Confirmation showed the date/time. Member My Appointment and filtered CRM list both showed Pending for MEMy001164526; CRM resource label Dorothy. An independent Playwright guest context no longer offered 10:00-10:30 (or the overlapping 10:15-10:45); first free slot was 10:30-11:00. No second booking or payment was submitted. Cleanup skipped at explicit user request: CRM Cancel opened Do you want to delete the item? with Delete/Cancel; user selected Keep the booking, so dialog was dismissed without Delete. Booking verified still Pending and reserved. Older CRM BUG-022 list-empty symptom was not observed, but linked-case retest was out of scope and bug status not changed.
